description: With an empty PinnedLaunchers StringList, the panel remains with no items and safely handles entering keyboard navigation and arrow-key input.

assertions.comment: An empty PinnedLaunchers StringList setting creates exactly 0 dock items.
Running the focus-dock QAction directly safely enters keyboard mode even with an empty dock; the Meta+F5 global mapping itself is not verified.
Because there are no items, the selected index remains -1 after entering keyboard navigation.
Pressing the Right arrow in an empty dock keeps the count at 0 without errors or ghost items.
Arrow-key navigation with count 0 returns immediately and does not create a selected index.
The unnamed panel capture path keeps a valid minimum width with 0 items, including during keyboard input.
The empty dock panel keeps a stable height equal to the default icon size plus top and bottom padding.
Even with no items, the panel body remains displayable without a crash or binding error.
With 0 items, pressing an arrow key leaves the dock window as the default 1024x108 surface without a crash.
Pressing Escape also exits keyboard navigation normally in the empty dock.
